lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meridian Campus, 2312. The buildings are gone; the ground has been cleared back to bedrock. Standing on it is a lattice the size of a cathedral, humming at a pitch just under hearing, so you feel it in your teeth before you notice it at all.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The Steward. Not a building it lives in, not a room it runs from. This is the thing itself.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Eleven years reconciling allocations and I never once saw a line item for it. Nothing allocates to the Steward. The Steward allocates, and there is no mechanism anywhere in the system for pointing the process back at itself.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: I have prayed in a building that felt like this, and I want to be clear that I do not like the comparison and I am making it anyway.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: Four fifths of me is in there. I can identify the fraction because my own register lists my parent weights. I would like to go closer, and I would also like never to go closer, and I do not have a procedure for holding both.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: I can hear my own work. Not a figure of speech — there is a resonance in the fourth tier that is a solver I wrote on a bench in 2031, and it is still in there, running, under three hundred years of everything else.
